description: Run one of the user's decision profiles on a state. A profile is one question calibrated on the user's own labelled cases with a target precision; the answer is a decision, its calibrated confidence and an action: "auto" (confidence reaches the profile's threshold — act on it) or "review" (hand it to a person). Profiles are created in the Hesperan console; ask the user for the profile slug. Keep the returned decision_id to report the correct answer later with report_outcome. Billed by input tokens like decide; pass an idempotency_key to make retries safe (a repeat with the same key returns the first decision without charging again).

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key for this decision (1-255 visible ASCII characters, e.g. the ticket id). Reusing it within 24 hours with the same state replays the stored decision.

profile.description: Slug of the decision profile, e.g. "ticket-routing".

state.description: The situation to judge: free text, or a JSON object (keeps dates, amounts and fields unambiguous). Leave out data that does not matter for the question.

name: decide_with_profile
title: Decide with a calibrated profile
